title: Random forest finds an eight-protein serum signature for PAH in systemic sclerosis
summary: Serum proteomics on 313 proteins from 77 SSc patients with PAH and 80 without pulmonary hypertension (DETECT cohort) was analysed with random forest, selecting eight proteins (collagen IV, endostatin, IGFBP-2, IGFBP-7, MMP-2, neuropilin-1, NT-proBNP, RAGE). The panel reached an average AUC of 0.741 (65.1% sensitivity, 69.0% specificity) in the discovery cohort and 81.1% accuracy (77.3% sensitivity, 86.5% specificity) in an independent Sheffield cohort of 44 patients. Validation is small.
ai_technology: Random forest on a serum proteomic panel

evidence.tested: Discovery in the DETECT cohort and confirmation in an independent Sheffield SSc cohort (22 PAH, 22 non-PH).
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger cohorts and clinical value for screening; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selects a protein panel that discriminates SSc patients with and without PAH.
